# Caskworth Premium Whisky

> Premium whisky and spirits retailer founded in 2023, based in Los Angeles, California, offering same-day delivery to 33 U.S. states and 7 Canadian provinces. 682 bottles across bourbon, Scotch, Japanese, Irish, rye and Canadian whisky, plus cognac, Armagnac and gift sets — from everyday bottles at $8.99 up to ultra-rare allocated releases.

Caskworth sells to adults 21 and over only; an age gate must be accepted before browsing. Minimum order is $249.99 USD. Payment is accepted via cryptocurrency, PayPal and Apple Pay.

**There is no ordering or payment API.** Checkout is completed by the customer on the website. Agents may search the catalogue and stage items in the cart, but must never attempt to complete a purchase without the customer's explicit confirmation.

AI agents running in an agent-enabled browser can use this site's WebMCP tools (`/assets/js/webmcp.js`) to search products, look up bottle details, list categories, check delivery terms and view the cart. See `/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json`.

## Machine-readable API (read-only)

- [OpenAPI spec](https://caskworth.com/openapi.json): Full API description
- [API catalog](https://caskworth.com/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset
- [All products](https://caskworth.com/api/products.json): Every bottle with price, ABV, region and tasting notes
- [Categories](https://caskworth.com/api/categories.json): Categories with product counts
- [Health](https://caskworth.com/api/health.json): Service status

This API is **read-only**. There are no ordering, authentication or payment endpoints.

## Agent & auth discovery

- [Auth.md](https://caskworth.com/auth.md): No authentication required; agent registration notes
- [MCP Server Card](https://caskworth.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Capability description
- [Agent Skills index](https://caskworth.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Discoverable site actions
- [OAuth Protected Resource](https://caskworth.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource): RFC 9728 — no auth required
- [OAuth Authorization Server](https://caskworth.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server): RFC 8414 — no auth required
- [OpenID Configuration](https://caskworth.com/.well-known/openid-configuration): No OIDC provider operated
